item.title: C792 HDMI-to-CSI Converter: Bridging 4K Input to 1080p@60Hz Output
item.description: The C792 HDMI-to-CSI-2 converter module is now available! This specialized converter designed for Raspberry Pi and Jetson platforms can transform 4K@60Hz HDMI input signals into 1080p@60Hz CSI-2 output, providing the perfect solution for your embedded video projects
item.content:encoded:
The C792 HDMI-to-CSI-2 converter module is now available! This specialized converter designed for Raspberry Pi and Jetson platforms can transform 4K@60Hz HDMI input signals into 1080p@60Hz CSI-2 output, providing the perfect solution for your embedded video projects with I2S audio capture.

🎯 Key Features​

  • 4K Input Support: Up to 4K@60Hz HDMI input capability
  • Dual Output: Simultaneous HDMI loop-out and CSI-2 conversion output
  • Audio Support: I2S digital audio capture
  • Wide Compatibility: Perfect support for Raspberry Pi series and Jetson platforms
  • Plug & Play: No complex configuration required, quick setup

🔌 Interface Configuration​

C792 provides two CSI-2 interfaces for different hardware:

  • 15-pin FPC: 2-lane, suitable for Raspberry Pi Zero/3B/4B
  • 22-pin FPC: 4-lane, suitable for Raspberry Pi CM4/5B and Jetson series

Besides, the I2S interface is also provided for audio capture.

🚀 Application Scenarios​

  • Media Centers: Game console/set-top box video capture
  • Industrial Monitoring: 1080p@60Hz video capture from manufacturing equipment
  • AI Development: Computer vision projects on Jetson platform

By the way, the C792 is originally designed for Raspberry Pi with proper mounting holes and screws.

And here is a typical user case:

  • You can use the C792 to capture the video output from a PC, loop it through to a local monitor, and convert the HDMI signal into a CSI signal for direct use with Raspberry Pi or other devices.
